title: Scope synchronous remote persistence rejection to the proxy rows owned by the operation
outcome: A rejected proxy retains retry duty without making another saved proxy's synchronous create, localization or delta operation report failure.
acceptance: A disposable two-proxy regression rejects one row and proves the healthy owned proxy succeeds after its own row and metadata commit.
Remote persistence owners attribute rejection to the rows they own and retain retry duty for rejected rows; local siblings and metadata remain successful.
